searches_tried: pipeline/comps.py: 'hawthorn premiers 2008 framed', 'hawthorn jumper signed framed', 'hawthorn premiership limited edition', 'hawthorn 2008 grand final'; work/comps.py same four. Only one genuine auction hit (Leski 2013); the rest are Armitage/Gowans local prices.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold: 'Hawthorn 2008 premiers framed jumper signed limited edition'; also 'Hawthorn 2008 premiership framed signed Rioli Franklin Hodge' and 'Hawthorn 2008 premiers framed 177/400'. Terapeak same terms. Check Leski, Lloyds, Gowans-Melbourne, Mossgreen, Memorabilia Auctions, Grays Online, Gumtree and sports memorabilia dealer sites (Sportsworld, Gone Memorabilia, Gee Dee Sports) for 2008 premiership frames, with certificate and edition size noted.
viewing_check: Check the plaque and look for a certificate of authenticity or hologram (maker, e.g. Sports Memorabilia licensed product) on back; zoom on signature cards to judge hand signed versus printed (ink sheen, pressure, repeat identical strokes); confirm jumper is a replica not match worn; measure frame and check glass for damage, fading and foxing.
